name: io.github.chrischall/harristeeter-mcp
description: Harris Teeter grocery pickup — search, cart, pickup times and checkout via your browser

environmentVariables.name: HARRISTEETER_DEBUG
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 for verbose bridge logging to stderr.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_USER_TZ
environmentVariables.description: IANA time zone sent with pickup-time requests (default America/New_York).

environmentVariables.name: KROGER_API_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional Kroger developer app id: product search and prices without the browser.

environmentVariables.name: HARRISTEETER_LOCATION_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional 8-digit store id for bridge-free search; a store saved with ht_set_store wins.

environmentVariables.name: HARRISTEETER_STATE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where the saved and remembered store live (default ~/.harristeeter-mcp).

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Bind interface for the fetchproxy concentrator (default 127.0.0.1; a literal IP only). For a hosted child in its own network namespace only — never bind a laptop's concentrator to the network.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_IDENTITY_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path where fetchproxy stores its long-term identity keypair (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/). For a host that runs a separate child per caller, so they share one identity.
